items.name: Claude usage
items.description: How much of Claude's five-hour and weekly limits you've used, and when each one resets.

history.note: Two pills across the top of the canvas instead of bars beside the chat.
First version.

items.name: Director
items.description: Makes short motion videos with wibblets, captions and sound, pins each one to the canvas as a playable film, and renders it to MP4.

history.note: First version.

items.name: Walkthrough
items.description: Films a persona using your app and cuts it into a calm captioned video, with numbered steps and chapters, for QA by watching or a demo.

history.note: Its own wibblet: a camcorder.
First version.

items.name: Scout
items.description: Finds real people worth talking to about one market and adds them to your Discovery board, without ever contacting anyone.

history.note: Writes people into the Discovery kit's shared store; uses Apollo when you pick it.
First version.

items.name: Asker
items.description: Drafts short call requests, a one-page call sheet and follow-ups for customer-discovery calls; you send every message.

history.note: Asks, call sheets and follow-ups go to the To send page, tagged with the bet they were written for.
First version.

items.name: Debrief
items.description: Scores a customer-discovery call on the earlyvangelist ladder, quoting the person's own words as evidence.

history.note: Notes the pain each person described, and suggests a sharper bet when the calls point elsewhere.
Pins each call card once, as html, instead of a draft first.
First version.

items.name: Discovery kit
items.description: Customer discovery for founders in four steps: find people, ask for calls, score each call on a hair-on-fire ladder, and let your bet get sharper as calls come in.

history.note: Rebuilt like Lead finder: four steps, Find people, a bet that gets sharper as calls come in.
Four zones in one row, lined up as they land. Plan and Clutter are gone.
Call cards fit inside Calls.
The Discovery zone fits its board.
First version.

items.name: Trim
items.description: Quietly removes old tool output your agents no longer need, so every request costs less. Shows what it saved.

history.note: The judge is a helper: press Set up once and Wibble runs it only while Trim uses it.
Cuts only when they pay back; hover shows the working; live prices.
First version.

items.name: Apollo
items.description: Find people in Apollo by title, place and company size for free, then reveal work emails only when you say so. Shows your credit balance.

history.note: A slow reveal stops in time to hand back what it paid for; people Apollo couldn't reach stay retryable; clearer key errors.
First version.

items.name: Lead scout
items.description: Turns a note about who you want to reach into filters, finds people who fit, and adds them to your lead board. Never spends credits or contacts anyone.

history.note: Adds people to the Lead finder kit's shared store, only people who are not there yet.
First version.

items.name: Outreach asker
items.description: Writes one email, call sheet or LinkedIn note per person for the ways you chose to reach them; you send every message.

history.note: Drafts go to the To send page instead of separate cards, and a draft already there is never rewritten.
First version.

items.name: Lead finder kit
items.description: Find people to reach, pick how to reach each one, and get drafts to send. Works with Apollo (free search, credits only when you say so), web search or your own list.

history.note: A progress strip says what is next and why, the lead board shares one store with a new To send page (Copy, Sent), and every zone note says what triggers it.
Each zone has its own colour, and Leads and To send are wider with more room between the zones.
The ask card comes first, rows have a clear gap, and every zone is tall enough that nothing needs scrolling when the kit is new.
Cards now have their own widths and sit in two even rows, with the lead board wide and the notes narrow.
All four zones stand at one height and scroll inside, so the kit stays one even row as drafts arrive.
Who to find and Leads stand at one fixed height and scroll inside, so the kit's zones line up.
Picks always go to this kit's own zones, even when another zone has the same name.
Pages no longer stack on top of each other; boards fit two cards across.
First version.
